data.one_liner: Wrap any widget with an inner shadow effect
data.what_it_does: This package provides an InnerShadow widget that applies an inner shadow to its child. It accepts a list of Shadow objects to customize the effect.
use_when: You want a simple inner shadow on a widget
You need a quick visual enhancement without custom painting
avoid_when: You need complex or dynamic shadow effects
Performance is critical and you want to avoid extra paint layers
strengths: Very small API, only one widget to use
No external dependencies, works on all platforms
weaknesses: No support for dynamic or animated shadows
